title: Studio apartment
goal: A reader must be able to see sleeping, cooking, and living functions in one compact room with a separate bathroom.

rubric.must: One large labeled studio room contains the bed, living furniture, and kitchen equipment.
A separate enclosed bathroom with a door, toilet, sink, and shower is visible.
The displayed room areas add up to less than 30 square metres.
The main studio space has no interior partitions dividing its sleeping, living, and cooking areas.
The entry door opens into clear floor space without striking furniture.
Windows are visible on the outside walls of both the studio and bathroom.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the floorplan exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The drawing visibly presents a compact 27.9 m² studio with sleeping, living, and cooking functions together in one open room, plus a separately enclosed and fully equipped bathroom. The entry circulation and required exterior windows are also clearly shown.

items.evidence: The large room labeled “STUDIO LIVING / SLEEP / COOK” visibly contains a double bed, sofa, coffee table, kitchen counter, sink, stove, and refrigerator.
A separately enclosed room labeled “BATHROOM” is visible with its own inward-swinging door, toilet, sink, and shower.
The displayed areas are 23.9 m² for the studio and 4.0 m² for the bathroom, totaling 27.9 m².
No interior partitions divide the sleeping, living, and cooking furniture within the main studio room.
The south entry door swings inward into visibly open floor space and does not strike the kitchen counter, wardrobe, or other furniture.
Exterior windows are visibly shown on the studio’s north and west walls and on the bathroom’s east wall.
